_note: Declared assumptions of the transport-based TBR model (model v2). Every value here is an assumption of this capsule, chosen before any design was evaluated with transport. Values marked unverified could not be checked against a primary source in this environment.
nuclear_data: FENDL-3.2c MATXS, 211 neutron groups, 293.6 K, data/nuclear/ (verified by ndata_verify.py)

source.angular: isotropic incident angular flux on the plasma-side boundary, normalised to unit incident current
source.boundaries: vacuum on both sides (neutrons returning to the plasma are lost; conservative for a torus)

tbr_definition: tritons produced in Li-6 and Li-7 (MATXS .h3 production), per incident neutron, times blanket coverage (constants.coverage); tritium produced in other nuclides (Be-9, structure) is reported separately and not counted

isotopic_abundance_atom_fraction._note: Natural abundances; W-180 (0.12 %) omitted and W renormalised; O-17/O-18 and deuterium omitted. Li isotopics are the design variable e_li6.

PbLi.status: Pb-15.7Li eutectic; density is an assumed value near 600 K, unverified

EUROFER.status: minor elements (Mn, V, Ta, C) omitted and lumped into Fe; unverified

water.status: matches constants.rho of the surrogate (15.5 MPa, ~300 C)

Be.status: multiplier layer taken as fully dense beryllium (the surrogate's multiplier inventory constant is named be_inventory_rate)

volume_fraction.EUROFER: f_steel (= f_struct + f_tube, as in the surrogate)

omitted: first wall (the surrogate has none; included identically in neither model)
S(alpha,beta) bound-hydrogen thermal scattering (free-gas H-1 data)
3-D geometry, ports and gaps (represented only by the coverage factor)

cylinder._note: Model v2c: the poloidal cross-section as an infinite circular cylinder (toroidal curvature neglected). Neutrons leaving the blanket front cross the plasma chamber and re-enter on the far side, replacing the slab's vacuum/white idealisations. Ports and divertor remain represented by constants.coverage.
cylinder.radii_status: assumed, approximately EU-DEMO-like minor radius plus a 0.2 m vacuum gap; unverified
cylinder.source: 14.1 MeV, isotropic, uniform over the plasma cross-section (a real plasma source is centrally peaked)
cylinder.numerics_status: step differencing in space and angle (first order, positive, conservative); P1 scattering (slab: P1 vs P3 changed TBR by 0.14 %)
